policy: A GitHub repository that is not archived is not automatically considered maintained. The status below describes only facts verified during this audit and the editorial treatment recommended for api.bnf.fr.

wrappers.name: PyGallica
wrappers.recommendation: Keep only with an explicit historical/archived warning and point existing users to the tested compatibility layer.

wrappers.name: Gallipy
wrappers.recommendation: Do not infer active maintenance from the non-archived flag. Mention the 2026 compatibility fixes for async IIIF and PDF reconstruction.

wrappers.name: fdh-gallica
wrappers.recommendation: Do not present as a current recommended wrapper until the historical EPFL link and project location are verified.

wrappers.name: Pyllica
wrappers.recommendation: Keep the conceptual documentation but replace transport/download examples with quota-aware, Issues-based implementations.

wrappers.name: bnfimage
wrappers.recommendation: Document the 2026 quota/429 compatibility patch; do not imply institutional BnF support.

wrappers.name: gargallica
wrappers.recommendation: Document the HTTPS and .texteBrut rate-limit compatibility patch; do not imply institutional BnF support.
